name: Delete an email campaign
description: Delete an email campaign. Delete an email campaign by its campaign ID. Only campaigns that have not been scheduled can be deleted; attempting to delete a campaign that has already been scheduled will return a 403 permission denied error. Related data in templates, newsletter builder, and schedule collections is also cleaned up.
